title: MAY GOD DEPEND ON YOU?
author: William C. Martin
stanzas: In the warfare that is raging For the truth and for the right, When the conflict, fierce, is raging With the powers of the night, God needs people brave and true: May He then depend on you?
See, they come on sable pinions, Come in strong, Satanic might,' Powers come, and dark dominions, From the regions of the night; God requires the brave and true: May He then depend on you?
From His throne the Father sees us; Angels help us to prevail; And our leader true is Jesus, And we shall not, cannot fail: Triumph crowns the brave and true,' May the Lord depend on you?
chorus: May the Lord depend on you? Loyalty is but His due; Say, O spirit, brave and true, That He may depend on you.
